search_text: published ZDI-08-036 ZDI-CAN-341 CA ETrust Secure Content Manager Gateway FTP LIST Stack Overflow Vulnerability 2008-06-04 CVE-2008-2541 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2008-2541 ['Computer Associates'] ['eTrust Secure Content Manager'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Computer Associates eTrust Secure Content Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the HTTP Gateway service icihttp.exe running on port 8080. When issuing a request for a FTP service the process tries to decorate the contents of the transaction. In this particular case by specifying a overly long response to a LIST command a stack buffer can be overflowed. Successful exploitation can lead to complete system compromise under the SYSTEM context. Computer Associates has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://support.ca.com/irj/portal/anonymous/phpsupcontent?contentID=177784 ['2008-05-23 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2008-06-04 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Sebastian Apelt (webmaster@buzzworld.org) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-08-036/
